label: EVENT_LOGIC_V3_D0_FREEZE_ERRATUM_V1
summary: Erratum for a metadata drift inside the historical V3-D0 freeze artifact. The freeze JSON was found to record interpolation-gap metadata that disagrees with the executable scientific authority. The historical freeze artifact is treated as IMMUTABLE: its committed bytes were restored (a previous cycle had edited the file in place); this separate erratum records the drift and the proof that the frozen executable behavior reproduces the accepted results. No executable behavior changed.

executable_authority.principle: The executable scientific code is the authority; the freeze JSON is documentation. The frozen executable was used for every accepted result and is unchanged.
executable_authority.executable_untouched: verified by git diff assertion in test_hurdle_prototype_v3.py::TestDocReconciliation::test_executable_untouched (Event Logic files byte-identical to committed HEAD)

replay_proof.statement: Replaying the FROZEN EXECUTABLE (PARAMS_V3D0, interp 0.30 / vel 0.20) on the frozen historical trajectory cache reproduces the recorded V2 magnitudes exactly. A 0.5/0.5 executable cannot produce these values; therefore the accepted results were generated under 0.30/0.20 and the freeze-JSON 0.5/0.5 record is documentation drift only.
pinned_by_tests: test_hurdle_prototype_v3.py::TestFreezeDiscipline::test_historical_arm_replay_reproduces (2169 spot check: takeoff err +0.4123 / wc err -0.2872, and PARAMS_V3D0 identity 0.30/0.20)
